source_snapshot.title: 杯盖扣反后的三种笑
source_snapshot.subject_zh: 周叔把固定保温杯盖倒扣在长椅上，低头摸杯套露出不好意思的笑；琴姨看见后短短笑出声，双手仍放在自己膝上；阿迟只抬左嘴角笑，珊瑚橙旧帆布包放在脚边
source_snapshot.subject_en: Uncle Zhou has placed the fixed thermos lid upside down on the bench and looks down while touching the cloth sleeve with a sheepish smile; Aunt Qin notices and gives a brief laugh while both hands stay on her own knees; Achi smiles with only the left corner of his mouth, with his worn coral-orange canvas shoulder bag by his feet
source_snapshot.composition_zh: 三人坐在右下且脸不重叠，倒扣杯盖在周叔身边清楚可见；顶部与左侧留空
source_snapshot.composition_en: the three seated in the lower-right with separated faces, the upside-down lid clearly visible beside Uncle Zhou, leaving the top and left reserved regions empty
source_snapshot.visual_action: 杯盖留在长椅上且没人举起，测试三张不同笑脸和一个自然小失误
